invariant: Java converts generic `skinparam roundcorner N` into a root RoundCorner style. Every EntityImageDescription resolves its symbol-specific title signature with that root inheritance, stores the diameter in Fashion, and passes the same value to each concrete USymbol painter that consumes Fashion.RoundCorner. The consumer set at the pinned Java revision includes stack, artifact, rectangle, card, component, frame, folder, file, and collections. Consequently a DESCRIPTION stack cluster and those sibling symbols share the generic diameter unless a more specific declaration overrides it. Scaling happens only after these base coordinates are painted.
causal_divergence: Rust resolves only two stack-wide diameters and hardcodes the 2.5 radius in the other deployment symbol painters. The fresh checker observes the default diameter on both stack and artifact. Although the parser preserves the generic root declaration and raw skinparam, the effective symbol-specific diameter is not carried through the deployment render context and shape dispatch. This loses both generic inheritance and per-symbol override precedence.
planned_change: Resolve the effective final RoundCorner diameter from each concrete componentDiagram symbol-title or group signature with inherited root compatibility, then carry that per-symbol diameter through the deployment render context and shape dispatch. Parameterize every Rust painter corresponding to a pinned-Java USymbol consumer of Fashion.RoundCorner: stack, artifact, rectangle/agent, card, component, frame, folder, file, and collections. Preserve fixed geometry for symbols whose Java painter does not consume Fashion.RoundCorner. Specific componentDiagram symbol.title or group.symbol declarations continue to outrank generic root values. Do not derive any value from scaled SVG coordinates.
perturbation_axes: generic root roundcorner versus symbol-specific override
stack cluster versus explicit stack leaf versus multiple non-stack Fashion consumers
zero versus odd and even nonzero diameters
style declaration before versus after entity construction
renamed labels and changed child topology
scope_boundary: This mechanism owns DESCRIPTION/deployment propagation of resolved RoundCorner into Fashion-consuming symbol painters. It does not alter CLASS package selectors, stack path equations, dimensions, Graphviz layout, dispatch, generic SVG scaling, comparator behavior, baselines, or fixture eligibility.
acceptance: The preserved checker_description_cluster_odd_scale input passes diff_one --no-oracle for both stack and artifact corners.
Unit tests prove generic inheritance and symbol-specific override precedence across cluster and leaf consumers.
Fresh valid Java perturbations cover at least three Fashion-consuming symbol kinds and two independent style/topology axes.
The renderer suite and no-oracle product ratchet remain green.
An independent checker records an accepted verdict at the exact implementation revision.
forbidden_approaches: special-casing checker labels, scale 1.75, diameter 17, or known SVG coordinates
post-processing serialized rx, ry, or path strings
changing comparator tolerance, baselines, or fixture eligibility
folding CLASS empty-package selector repair into this mechanism
